# Tesla recalls 20K vehicles for headlight issue. See models

Portrait of Greta Cross Greta Cross

USA TODAY

Aug. 11, 2026, 10:45 a.m. ET

Tesla has recalled more than 20,000 vehicles for headlights that are too bright, posing a risk to the safety of others on the road. [...] Tesla, Inc. issued a recall for 20,349 Model 3 and Model Y vehicles because the headlight low beams may be too bright, exceeding the maximum light output, according to a National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) recall report.
